newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates softer amid loose liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates softer amid loose liquidity.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates were softer at midday on Thursday amid loose liquidity in the banking system at the start of a new reserve period, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate fell to 5.490 percent from Wednesday's 5.552 close, with 30-day commercial paper down to 5.40 from 5.60-5.75. However, dealers expected liquidity demand to emerge soon over routine monthly payroll demand, limiting pressure for further softness in the rates.
In the government bond market, the 10-year 84/1 yield was at 5.6700-6800, the seven-year 85/3 yield was at 5.5800 and the 10-year construction yield was at 5.6995. -Julie Hu (5080815)
